U.note: Tidy ring-and-card timer with correct end-time countdown and auto work/break switching, but tiny text, no aria roles or live announcements, and the ring barely visibly moves.

V.note: Huge legible time with phase colour change, solid timer logic, screen-reader timer and status, keyboard shortcuts and a good phone layout, though auto-advance, chime, notifications and persistence add bulk.

W.note: Distinctive monospace terminal look with correct logic and live announcements, but the ASCII bar, reset confirmation, text-only toggles and dense status lines make it overbuilt and harder to scan.

X.note: Focused full-screen timer with giant digits, colour-coded phase, pomodoro dots, timer role, live status and clean end-of-session flow, with only an unused done phase and a confirm dialog as blemishes.

Y.note: Compact dark ring timer that works, but no aria or live regions, skip counts as a finished pomodoro, a new AudioContext is made per beep, and small type hurts phone legibility.

Z.note: Most polished layout with a four-segment road to the long break, large clock, aria-live announcements and phone-friendly sizing, though restore-from-storage and auto-start features make it larger than a simple timer needs.
